items.label: Theorem 1
items.statementLatex:
\label{thm:main}
There exist $f\in C^2(\R^n)$, $x_0$, $H_0\succ0$ and positive step
lengths generating an infinite classical DFP sequence satisfying
\eqref{eq:armijo} and \eqref{eq:strong-curvature}, with
\[
 (1-\varepsilon)I\preceq\nabla^2f(x)\preceq(1+\varepsilon)I
 \quad(x\in\R^n),\qquad \|\nabla f(x_k)\|\to1.
\]
The Hessian is globally $\beta$-H\"older continuous and admits no
$\beta'$-H\"older bound on $\mathcal L_0$ for any $\beta'\in(\beta,1]$.
The origin is the unique minimizer, and the accumulation set is the
unit circle in a two-dimensional subspace of $\R^n$.

items.label: Theorem 4
items.statementLatex:
\label{thm:concrete}
There exists $\bar\sigma>0$ such that, for each fixed
$0<\sigma_*<\bar\sigma$ and all sufficiently large $j_0$, the construction
is well defined and yields a uniformly convex $f\in C^2(\R^2)$ with
a globally $1/2$-H\"older Hessian satisfying
\eqref{eq:prescribed-jets}--\eqref{eq:fixed-hessian-bound}.
The positive step lengths \eqref{eq:fixed-realization} generate exactly
$\{x_k,H_k\}$ by classical DFP with strong Wolfe parameters $(1/4,1/2)$,
with $\|\nabla f(x_k)\|\to1$ and the unit circle as accumulation set.

items.label: Lemma 8
items.statementLatex:
\label{lem:fixed-geometry}
For sufficiently large $j_0$, the tail products in
\eqref{eq:fixed-radii} converge and satisfy $\rho_k\downarrow1$.
The accumulation set of the prescribed points is the unit circle
$\Gamma$, and there is a constant $\kappa>0$, independent of $j_0$,
such that for every $m\ne k$,
\begin{equation}\label{eq:fixed-separation}
 \|x_m-x_k\|\ge\kappa
 \max\{\tau_{\lfloor m/2\rfloor},\tau_{\lfloor k/2\rfloor}\}.
\end{equation}
The prescribed values $\rho_k^2/2$ and gradients $g_k$ satisfy the
strong Wolfe conditions with $(\eta_1,\eta_2)=(1/4,1/2)$.

items.label: Corollary 12
items.statementLatex:
\label{cor:identity-initialization}
For every $n\ge2$, $0<\eta_1<\eta_2<1$, and $\beta\in(0,1)$,
there exist $\widetilde f\in C^2(\R^n)$ and $\widetilde x_0$ such that
$\nabla^2\widetilde f$ is globally $\beta$-H\"older continuous and
$mI\preceq\nabla^2\widetilde f(x)\preceq MI$ on $\R^n$, for some
$0<m\le M<\infty$. Classical DFP from $(\widetilde x_0,I)$ admits an
infinite strong Wolfe sequence with parameters $\eta_1,\eta_2$ and
$\liminf_k\|\nabla\widetilde f(\widetilde x_k)\|>0$.
Its accumulation set is an ellipse centered at the origin in a
two-dimensional subspace.
